failureContract.note: Separate contract sketch; not all checks target chosen integration implementation.

limits: Two local samples per condition; no confidence interval, CI or cross-browser performance claim.
Open control with reconnects is an observer failure despite complete passing app coverage; failed audit wall time is not a healthy speed comparison.
SSE byte count is actual serialized event bytes accepted by Node write, not TCP/TLS overhead. Browser view sizes are source characters, not bytes.
UI render duration measures synchronous JavaScript/DOM work, not compositor paint; latest-message-to-render metric is not oldest-queued-message latency.
Embedded overlay remains hidden during execution; its full postMessage transport is not the measured live observer transport.
Initial snapshots over 8MB cannot pass the current observer guard; chunked initialization or lazy detail delivery needs design.
Slow-reader proof bounds one connection; response.end does not immediately free queued data until peer reads/disconnects.
Candidate live metadata and output validation/replay/terminal persistence failures need full production hardening. Contract sketch evidence is not a claim those behaviors ship.
API drain covers admitted finite handlers, not later timers/background jobs.
Interactor selection helper and timing observer remain proposed upstream work; do not ship a Dyno fork.

conclusion.decision: Adopt canonical accepted outcomes and incremental observer delivery after hardening; keep existing result HTTP acknowledgements. This is a reporting reliability/bandwidth win, not an established wall-time speedup.

productionCutline: Validate allowed metadata/output fields and duplicate indices atomically.
Define result/terminal lost-acknowledgement handling; exact replay receipt currently covers only the last live update.
Prove interrupted output durability, persistence failure, screenshot cancellation and command responsiveness on chosen implementation.
Preserve complete reporter reconstruction, sequence/reconnect behavior and local routes/search/focus.
Design initialization for snapshots above 8MB and bound connection count/lifetime.
Land required supported Interactor changes upstream.
